summary: EN/AR/KA/SR frame the topic as an established genocide with similar details on atrocities, ICJ case, displacement and famine. HE frames exclusively as contested accusations, adds Israeli rebuttals, ICC warrants and rejection by US officials and Israeli research center. Death toll figures and cut-off dates vary across all editions. Recognition lists and specific casualty breakdowns (journalists, health workers) also differ in emphasis.
